description: User-installable hi-res recipe for Zelda - Ocarina of Time (USA) Rev 0. EMULATOR-VERIFIED ONLY: renders 640x480i in mupen64plus; not yet validated on real N64 hardware. Copy this file into ~/.n64patcher/patches/ and the .bps into the bundled hires_patches directory (or adjust the path) to enable it. Requires an Expansion Pak.

patches.name: Zelda - Ocarina of Time (USA) Rev 0 - 640x480i (EXPERIMENTAL)
patches.source: N64-Universal-Smart-Patcher project - built from the zeldaret/oot decomp, see scripts/oot_hires/
patches.notes: Runtime-width machinery enabled: ViMode 640x480i, framebuffers relocated to the Expansion Pak area, 3D viewport 640x480. Menus/HUD keep the original 320-space layout (upper-left quadrant), the same known limitation the SubDrag patches have. Needs an Expansion Pak. Hardware validation pending.
patches.outputs_note: Deliberately NOT declared: the CIC-6102 checksum window does not cover the patched code segment, so the output ROM keeps the clean dump's boot checksums. Declaring outputs here would key the clean dump as a hi-res output and make --hires skip it.
